PLEASE TAKE NOTICE that a Meeting of the Incline Village General Improvement District (IVGID) Board of Trustees will be
held starting at 4:00 PM on September 23, 2026, in the Boardroom, 893 Southwood Boulevard, Incline Village, Nevada.

Public Comment
Public Comments are welcomed during Public Comment Periods and are limited to 3 minutes per person per Public Comment Period.
Unused time may not be allocated to other speakers. A speaker’s viewpoint will not be restricted; however, reasonable restrictions
may be imposed upon the time, place, and manner of speech. Irrelevant statements, unduly repetitious statements, and personal
attacks that would objectively antagonize or incite others are examples of speech that may be reasonably limited. Not to include
comments on General Business items with scheduled public comments. The Board of Trustees may address matters brought up during
public comments at the conclusion of the comment period but may not deliberate on any non-agendized item.

Members of the public are welcome to provide public comments by telephone at (877) 853-5247 and in the Civic Plus Portal at:
https://www.yourtahoeplace.com/about-ivgid/ivgid-board-of-trustees/meeting-agendas-materials-minutes/.
The Webinar ID will be posted to the District Website on the day of the meeting, and will be available
at: https://www.yourtahoeplace.com/about-ivgid/ivgid-board-of-trustees/board-committee-meetings/.
The meeting will be available for viewing at: https://ivgid.portal.civicclerk.com/event/756/media.

ITEM F.1.
                            MEMORANDUM

TO:                Board of Trustees


FROM:              Robert Harrison, District General Manager

SUBJECT:           (Not For Possible Action) Presentation on Alternative
                   Concepts for Workforce Housing submitted to TTD by Rick
                   Burkette, Burkette Development Group LLC.

DATE:              September 23, 2026



I.    RECOMMENDATION
Receive the presentation.

II.    BACKGROUND
The TTD is considering the disposition of 771 Southwood Blvd. One of those
options includes a transfer to the Reno Housing Authority for the development of
low-income housing. The Board had previously received a presentation from the
Incline Sports Arena and Workforce Housing Group. As part of that consideration,
Burkette Development Group submitted a proposal for true Workforce
Housing. These proposals are included for information in the Board
packet. There is also a summary position paper from Rick Burkette which
provides some additional education on workforce housing.

The Board previously offered TTD the opportunity to hold a public meeting at the
Chateau. The only reply to that offer was the public comments provided by Andy
Hoffman from TTD and they did not accept the offer to meet.

III.    COMMENTS

IV.     ATTACHMENTS
1.     771_Southwood One Pager
2.     771 Southwood 54 Unit Workforce Housing Option TTD IVGID
3.     Affordable vs Workforce Housing
